name: text-blinds-reveal
title: Venetian Blinds Reveal
description: Khối chữ chia thành mười nan ngang, từng nan mở từ mép trên xuống cách nhau 0.05 giây như rèm sáo.

moworks.author: moworks

options.duration: s each strip opens from its top edge (0.6), ease-out quad
options.exit: s after the start when each strip folds to its bottom edge (0.5 s ease-in; null: stay)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Text box (first baseline − 0.95 em to last + 0.28 em) cut into 10 equal horizontal strips (copies clipped with inset); strip i opens from its top edge (clip bottom 100 % → 0) in 0.6 s easeOutQuad (CSS cubic-bezier(.5,1,.89,1); labelled power2.out) from 0.3 + 0.05·i s; seams vanish when open. Close: each strip folds to its bottom edge, 0.5 s easeInQuad, same 50 ms stagger (demo from 2.8 s); loop 4 s. Params: slats: số nan (10) · duration (0.6 s) · stagger (0.05 s) · ease (easeOutQuad).
moworks.titleVi: Chữ hiện qua mười nan rèm
